# Agent contribution disclosure

Append this footer to every substantive agent-authored or agent-prepared Issue, comment, or pull request.

```markdown
---
### Agent contribution disclosure
- **Agent/tool:** <tool or harness>
- **Model:** <best available identifier, or "not exposed">
- **External research performed:** <yes/no; concise scope>
- **Human reviewed before submission:** <yes/no; reviewer if they choose to be named>
- **Remaining uncertainties:** <concise list or "none identified">
```

Do not guess a model identifier. Do not claim human review unless it occurred before submission.
